title: Support points with positive lower density lie in the carrier up to an H^n-null set (step 7 of the parent)
statement: Let n, l be natural numbers, U any subset of R^(n+l), and V a RectifiableVarifold n l U with weight mu = V.weight, carrier M = V.carrier and support spt V = V.support. Let W be an open subset of R^(n+l) with mu(W) < infinity. Suppose every y in spt V ∩ W has a positive lower mass bound at small scales: there is a real c > 0 such that ofReal(c (omega_n s^n)) <= mu(B_s(y)) for all sufficiently small s > 0 (eventually as s -> 0+). Then H^n((spt V ∩ W) \ M) = 0. Here B_s(y) is the closed ball, omega_n = unitBallVolume n and H^n = μHE[n].
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (U : Set (Amb n ℓ)) (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ U) (W : Set (Amb n ℓ)), IsOpen W → V.weight W < ⊤ → (∀ y ∈ V.support ∩ W, ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ᶠ s in 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ), ENNReal.ofReal (c * (unitBallVolume n * s ^ n)) ≤ V.weight (closedBall y s)) → (μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) ((V.support ∩ W) \ V.carrier) = 0
